title: task complete on a record already at the terminal status should relocate it, not error Illegal task transition
description:
Reported by lore-cli (2026-09-18, cross-session message): a specialist ran `quest task edit --status "Done"` instead of `quest task complete`. Per QCLI-221 (Done), that is intentional and correct -- status and on-disk location are deliberately independent, and `task edit --status <terminal>` legitimately leaves the record in tasks/. QCLI-221 also already decided `quest doctor` should NOT flag a Done record sitting outside completed/, since that would be a false positive against this exact design. Neither of those decisions is being reopened here.

The real gap is narrower: once a record is at the terminal status but still stored in tasks/, there is no direct command to finish the tasks/ -> completed/ relocation if someone wants it. `quest task complete <id>` fails with `Illegal task transition: Done -> Done`, because the transform used by TaskService.complete() (src/application/tasks/tasks.ts) unconditionally calls transitionTask(task, terminal, policy) before moveTask ever reaches its own already-at-destination check -- so the transitionTask ladder check (position+1) throws first, for any task already sitting at the terminal status, regardless of storage location. (Note: `task archive` does not have this problem -- archive() has no transform and moves any record regardless of status.)

lore-cli worked around it with `quest task demote <id> --to "In Progress"` then `quest task complete <id>`, which works but is a non-obvious two-command dance for something that reads like it should be one command.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest task complete <id> succeeds and relocates the record to .quest/completed/ when its status is already the terminal status but it is still stored in tasks/, instead of erroring Illegal task transition: <status> -> <status>
The fix is scoped to complete; task edit --status <terminal> continues to not relocate, per QCLI-221, which this task does not reopen

Whether finalSummary/unresolvedAtCompletion are (re)computed on this no-op-status completion path is a documented decision on this task, reconciled with QCLI-336's computed-once-at-real-completion model for a record that never actually went through complete() before

Tests cover: completing a task that reached the terminal status via edit while still in tasks/ (the exact shape lore-cli hit) without needing the demote-then-complete workaround, and that completing a record already located at completed/ still errors exactly as it does today
quest help task complete documents the no-op-status relocation behavior
